compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

The scheduled **Test Suite (mirror)** sweep legs `sweep (macos, full suite)`, `sweep (windows)`, `sweep (py3.15)` and `sweep (py3.14t)` fail the same 6 review-bot tests with `AttributeError: 'State' object has no attribute 'config'` (latest: run 41696793491; earlier 41338211499, 41503532529, 41555561498, 41591840011, 41638314556):

- `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_lifespan_starts_and_stops_snapshot_janitor`, `::test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs`, `::test_lifespan_can_opt_into_the_real_reconcile_loop`
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot_in_flight.py::test_health_endpoint_reports_the_in_flight_count`, `::test_health_endpoint_reports_the_queue_depth`, `::test_health_endpoint_reports_degraded_when_gerrit_auth_is_broken`

## Root cause (reproduced)

Every failing leg installs with unlocked `uv pip install '.[dev,reviewbot,ui]'` and resolves **pytest 9.2.0**; the passing legs use `uv.lock` (pytest 9.0.3). pytest 9.2.0 (upstream PR pytest-dev/pytest#14962, for #10644) changed `MonkeyPatch.setattr` on instances: it records the old value from `target.__dict__` instead of `getattr`. Starlette's `State` stores attributes in its private `_state` dict, so `app.state.__dict__` never holds `config`; the recorded old value is "absent" and teardown runs `delattr(app.state, "config")`, deleting the module-level config. Later tests that patch `config` with the default `raising=True`, or run `lifespan`, then fail. Upstream fixes are open and unmerged (#15100, #15118, #15136, #15323).

Deterministic reproduction (pytest 9.2.0, FastAPI 0.162.0, Starlette 1.10.0, no xdist):
`pytest -p no:xdist tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_accepted_rerun_survives_restart_via_gerrit_reconcile tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_lifespan_starts_and_stops_snapshot_janitor` -> 1 failed, 1 passed. Same venv with only pytest swapped to 9.0.3 -> 2 passed. Polluting test: `test_accepted_rerun_survives_restart_via_gerrit_reconcile` (its `monkeypatch.setattr(appmod.app.state, "config", cfg, raising=False)`); every other `monkeypatch.setattr` on `app.state` has the same effect.

## Approach

Stop patching Starlette `State` attributes through `monkeypatch.setattr`, and patch the backing dict instead: `monkeypatch.setitem(<app>.state._state, "<name>", value)`. `setitem` reads and restores the dict entry directly, so it restores correctly on every pytest version (and removes the key when it was absent, which preserves the `raising=False` intent). Convert all 11 `monkeypatch.setattr(...app.state, ...)` sites in `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py`, `tests/unit/test_review_bot_retrigger.py`, `tests/unit/test_review_bot_in_flight.py` and `tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py`. Also convert the 3 bare `app.state.config = ...` assignments in `tests/unit/test_review_bot_token_redaction.py` and `tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py`, which replace a shared app's config and never restore it (the same test-isolation leak). `monkeypatch.delattr` is unaffected (it still reads via `getattr`) and stays.

Fix the class with a guard test, `tests/unit/test_app_state_patch_guard.py`: an AST scan of `tests/` that fails on any `.setattr(<expr>.state, ...)` call and any bare assignment to `<expr>.app.state.<name>`, naming file:line and the sanctioned `setitem` form. It also proves the sanctioned form restores a pre-existing entry and removes an absent one on a real Starlette `State`. No autouse fixtures, no new helper modules, no skips, no production code change.

## Scope

In: the 6 test files above and the new guard test. Out: `uv.lock` / pytest version pins (the suite must pass on both 9.0.3 and 9.2.0); the other unrelated `sweep (windows)` failures.

## Testing

- The guard test fails on the current tree (it lists the 14 sites) and passes after the conversion.
- The two-test reproduction above passes under pytest 9.2.0 after the fix.
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot*.py`, `test_path_injection_guards.py`, `test_opcert_service_app.py` and the guard pass in both the locked venv (pytest 9.0.3) and an unlocked latest-resolution venv (pytest 9.2.0).
- `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] [non-codebase] A deterministic local reproduction is recorded on this ticket, with the test that leaves `app.state` without `config`.
  provenance: environment=local macOS worktree, unlocked latest-resolution venv with pytest 9.2.0, FastAPI 0.162.0, Starlette 1.10.0; principal=session a85e3cd3; privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=simulation — the CI leg's failure was reproduced locally with a State.__delattr__ tracer plugin and recorded in this ticket's 2026-11-03 reproduction comment: 1 failed, 1 passed under 9.2.0, 2 passed with only pytest set to 9.0.3
- [x] A regression test fails before the fix and passes after it.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py` and `tests/unit/test_review_bot_in_flight.py` pass in one process under pytest 9.2.0 and under pytest 9.0.3.
- [x] [non-codebase] On the first scheduled Test Suite (mirror) run on a main containing the fix, `sweep (macos, full suite)` reports 0 failures in the review-bot test modules.
  provenance: environment=GitHub Actions macos-latest, scheduled Test Suite (mirror) run 41749721339 on main c6f116f1ae8, which contains merged fix 9b3db409803; principal=session a85e3cd3; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read-only gh API read of job 126311527814: concluded success with 20492 passed, 81 skipped, 0 failed and no `'State' object has no attribute` lines
